The apartment

From the entry to the balcony.

The entry opens alongside the kitchen, where the island faces the living and dining area. Beyond it, floor-to-ceiling glass frames the balcony.

European oak runs through the entry, kitchen, dining and living areas. Both bedrooms are carpeted, with mirrored built-in robes. The main bedroom has its own ensuite.

  • KitchenMarble benchtops, a waterfall-edge island, Miele appliances, a dark mosaic splashback, black tapware, open shelving and a linear pendant above the island.
  • BathroomsFloor-to-ceiling tiling, frameless glass showers, wall-hung basins, timber-lined mirror niches and black tapware.
  • ClimateDucted air conditioning throughout, with ceiling fans in the living room and both bedrooms.
  • BalconyGlass balustrade, with direct access from the living area and main bedroom.
  • Car parkOne secure basement car space.

The building

Chester & Ella.

Designed by Hayball and completed in 2019, Chester & Ella comprises two towers at 7 Chester Street and 14 Ella Street. 508 is in the Chester tower.

RooftopInfinity-edge pool, covered terrace, outdoor dining and a barbecue.
Podium gardenLandscaped terrace with lounges, dining tables and a barbecue.
GymCardio equipment, a cable station and a dumbbell rack.
Private diningResidents’ dining room with a stone island, induction cooktop and a long table.
Residents’ loungeLounge seating and a large wall-mounted screen.
Games roomPool table and bar seating.
EntryStreet-level lobby lounge with secure intercom access.
